notes.en: By eight o’clock yesterday I had finished my project, and at eight I was reading a book.
notes.ru: К восьми часам вчера я закончил проект, а в восемь читал книгу.
notes.why: By eight — завершено раньше: Past Perfect (had finished); at eight — процесс в момент: Past Continuous (was reading).

notes.en: By six o’clock father had returned home, and at six thirty he was having dinner.
notes.ru: К шести часам отец вернулся домой, а в половине седьмого ужинал.
notes.why: By six — завершено к моменту: Past Perfect (had returned); at six thirty — процесс: Past Continuous (was having).

notes.en: By ten o’clock yesterday grandmother had watered the plants, and at eleven she was knitting a scarf.
notes.ru: К десяти часам вчера бабушка полила растения, а в одиннадцать вязала шарф.
notes.why: By ten — Past Perfect (had watered); at eleven — действие в процессе: Past Continuous (was knitting).

notes.en: When I met Kate, she was drinking coffee which she had bought in a small café nearby.
notes.ru: Когда я встретил Кейт, она пила кофе, который купила в маленьком кафе поблизости.
notes.why: Met — Past Simple; was drinking — процесс в тот момент; покупка раньше — Past Perfect (had bought).

notes.en: When mother came home, we were baking a cake which we had started in the morning.
notes.ru: Когда мама пришла домой, мы пекли торт, который начали утром.
notes.why: Came — Past Simple; were baking — процесс в тот момент; начали раньше, in the morning — Past Perfect (had started).

notes.en: When I saw Lily, she was arranging the books which she had taken from the library.
notes.ru: Когда я увидел Лили, она раскладывала книги, которые взяла в библиотеке.
notes.why: Saw — Past Simple; was arranging — процесс; взяла раньше — Past Perfect (had taken).

notes.en: When I came home yesterday, I saw that my little brother had spilled juice on my notebook and was trying to clean it.
notes.ru: Когда я вчера пришёл домой, я увидел, что мой младший брат пролил сок на мою тетрадь и пытается его вытереть.
notes.why: Came, saw — Past Simple; пролил раньше — Past Perfect (had spilled); пытался в тот момент — Past Continuous (was trying).

notes.en: When I opened the window, I noticed that the birds had already flown away.
notes.ru: Когда я открыл окно, я заметил, что птицы уже улетели.
notes.why: Opened, noticed — Past Simple; улетели раньше, с already — Past Perfect (had flown).

notes.en: When I entered the classroom, the students were writing a test and the teacher was checking their homework.
notes.ru: Когда я вошёл в класс, ученики писали контрольную, а учитель проверял их домашние работы.
notes.why: Entered — Past Simple; два действия шли одновременно в тот момент — Past Continuous (were writing, was checking).

notes.en: When I arrived home, my sister was drawing a picture which she had started the day before.
notes.ru: Когда я пришёл домой, моя сестра рисовала картину, которую начала накануне.
notes.why: Arrived — Past Simple; was drawing — процесс; начала the day before — Past Perfect (had started).

notes.en: When I rang my friend, she was still reading the article which she had begun two hours earlier.
notes.ru: Когда я позвонил подруге, она всё ещё читала статью, которую начала два часа назад.
notes.why: Rang — Past Simple; was still reading — процесс (still); начала раньше — Past Perfect (had begun).

notes.en: When I looked out of the window, the kids were riding their bikes, and the sun was shining brightly.
notes.ru: Когда я выглянул в окно, дети катались на велосипедах, а солнце ярко светило.
notes.why: Looked — Past Simple; два длительных фона в тот момент — Past Continuous (were riding, was shining).

notes.en: When I entered the kitchen, the cat was sitting near the stove and was watching mother cooking dinner.
notes.ru: Когда я вошёл на кухню, кот сидел у плиты и смотрел, как мама готовит ужин.
notes.why: Entered — Past Simple; sitting и watching — процессы в тот момент, Past Continuous (was sitting, was watching).

notes.en: When the guests arrived, we were still decorating the room.
notes.ru: Когда прибыли гости, мы всё ещё украшали комнату.
notes.why: Arrived — Past Simple; still — действие шло в момент прихода, Past Continuous (were still decorating).

notes.en: When I met John at the park, he was walking his dog which he had adopted a week before.
notes.ru: Когда я встретил Джона в парке, он гулял со своей собакой, которую взял неделей раньше.
notes.why: Met — Past Simple; was walking — процесс; a week before — раньше, Past Perfect (had adopted).

notes.en: I arrived at the airport very late because I had lost my ticket on the way. When I came to the gate, I saw Jack who was standing near the counter. He was waiting for me as he had forgotten his passport at home.
notes.ru: Я приехал в аэропорт очень поздно, потому что по дороге потерял билет. Когда я подошёл к выходу, я увидел Джека, который стоял у стойки. Он ждал меня, потому что забыл дома паспорт.
notes.why: Arrived, came, saw — Past Simple; потерял и забыл раньше — Past Perfect (had lost, had forgotten); стоял и ждал — процессы, Past Continuous.

notes.en: When I woke up, it was already half past eight. I called my sister. Nobody answered. She had already gone to work.
notes.ru: Когда я проснулся, было уже половина девятого. Я позвонил сестре. Никто не ответил. Она уже ушла на работу.
notes.why: Woke, was, called, answered — Past Simple (последовательность событий); had already gone — ушла раньше, Past Perfect.

notes.en: I opened the curtains. The rain had stopped and the sun was shining. The trees in the garden were moving in the wind.
notes.ru: Я открыл шторы. Дождь закончился, и светило солнце. Деревья в саду качались на ветру.
notes.why: Opened — Past Simple; дождь закончился раньше — Past Perfect (had stopped); was shining, were moving — процессы, Past Continuous.

notes.en: When the storm stopped, I looked outside and saw a rainbow. The children were playing in the yard and were laughing loudly.
notes.ru: Когда гроза закончилась, я выглянул на улицу и увидел радугу. Дети играли во дворе и громко смеялись.
notes.why: Looked, saw — Past Simple; гроза закончилась раньше (допустим и Past Simple); were playing, were laughing — Past Continuous.

notes.en: When I called my colleague, they told me that he had left for a meeting an hour before.
notes.ru: Когда я позвонил коллеге, мне сказали, что он ушёл на совещание час назад.
notes.why: Called, told — Past Simple; an hour before — уход раньше момента разговора, Past Perfect (had left).

notes.en: When I got to the café, my friend had not arrived yet, so I ordered tea and read the newspaper.
notes.ru: Когда я пришёл в кафе, моего друга там ещё не было, поэтому я заказал чай и стал читать газету.
notes.why: Got, ordered, read — Past Simple; yet — друг не пришёл к моменту прихода, Past Perfect (had not arrived).

notes.en: He wanted to visit the museum where he had worked many years ago.
notes.ru: Он хотел посетить музей, где много лет назад работал.
notes.why: Wanted — Past Simple; работа в музее была раньше желания — Past Perfect (had worked), many years ago.

notes.en: The message had arrived just a few minutes before he left.
notes.ru: Сообщение пришло всего за несколько минут до того, как он ушёл.
notes.why: Left — Past Simple; just a few minutes before — приход раньше, Past Perfect (had arrived).

notes.en: He returned home late yesterday evening.
notes.ru: Вчера вечером он вернулся домой поздно.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): yesterday evening — конкретное время в прошлом.

notes.en: She is very happy: she has completed her project at last.
notes.ru: Она очень счастлива: наконец-то она закончила свой проект.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has + V3): результат важен сейчас, at last — она счастлива.

notes.en: By noon he had translated all the documents.
notes.ru: К полудню он перевёл все документы.
notes.why: Past Perfect (had translated): by noon — завершено к моменту в прошлом.

notes.en: I have never visited Paris.
notes.ru: Я никогда не был в Париже.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have never visited): жизненный опыт до настоящего момента, never.

notes.en: Last year we travelled to the mountains every weekend.
notes.ru: В прошлом году мы каждые выходные ездили в горы.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): last year — закончившийся период в прошлом.

notes.en: When I had finished breakfast, I went to the park.
notes.ru: Когда я закончил завтрак, я пошёл в парк.
notes.why: Went — Past Simple; завтрак закончился раньше — Past Perfect (had finished); Past Simple тоже допустим при последовательности.

notes.en: I have not seen you for months! How have you been?
notes.ru: Я не видел тебя несколько месяцев! Как ты поживаешь?
notes.why: Present Perfect (have not seen): for months — период до настоящего момента.

notes.en: When did you watch the film “Inception”?
notes.ru: Когда ты смотрел фильм «Начало»?
notes.why: Past Simple (did you watch): вопрос с when о конкретном времени в прошлом.

notes.en: My brother has already graduated from university.
notes.ru: Мой брат уже окончил университет.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has graduated): already — результат важен сейчас.

notes.en: He repaired the bike which he had bought the day before.
notes.ru: Он починил велосипед, который купил накануне.
notes.why: Repaired — Past Simple; покупка раньше, the day before — Past Perfect (had bought).

notes.en: I saw an interesting performance last night.
notes.ru: Вчера вечером я видел интересный спектакль.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): last night — конкретное прошлое время.

notes.en: Have you ever been to the British Museum?
notes.ru: Ты когда-нибудь был в Британском музее?
notes.why: Present Perfect (have you ever been): вопрос об опыте жизни, ever.

notes.en: They were painting the fence all day yesterday.
notes.ru: Вчера они красили забор весь день.
notes.why: Past Continuous (were + Ving): длительное действие all day yesterday.

notes.en: I have just met Anna on my way home.
notes.ru: Я только что встретил Анну по дороге домой.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have just met): just — недавнее действие с результатом сейчас.

notes.en: She was playing the piano from five till seven.
notes.ru: Она играла на пианино с пяти до семи.
notes.why: Past Continuous (was playing): длительное действие в отрезке from five till seven.

notes.en: Look! He has drawn a very funny picture.
notes.ru: Смотри! Он нарисовал очень смешную картинку.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has drawn): Look! — результат виден сейчас.

notes.en: At this time yesterday I was talking to my friend on the phone.
notes.ru: Вчера в это время я разговаривал с другом по телефону.
notes.why: Past Continuous (was talking): At this time yesterday — процесс в конкретный момент.

notes.en: My favorite series had started right before I came home.
notes.ru: Мой любимый сериал начался прямо перед тем, как я пришёл домой.
notes.why: Came — Past Simple; начало сериала раньше, right before — Past Perfect (had started), допустим и Past Simple.

notes.en: I have not eaten pizza since last month.
notes.ru: Я не ел пиццу с прошлого месяца.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have not eaten): since last month — период до настоящего момента.

notes.en: I understood that he had not told the truth.
notes.ru: Я понял, что он не сказал правду.
notes.why: Understood — Past Simple; Past Perfect (had not told) — неправда раньше, либо Past Continuous (was not telling) — в тот момент.

notes.en: She was washing the floor when I entered the room.
notes.ru: Она мыла пол, когда я вошёл в комнату.
notes.why: Длительное действие — Past Continuous (was washing); его прервало короткое — Past Simple (entered).

notes.en: It’s all right: she has found the keys at last.
notes.ru: Всё в порядке: она наконец нашла ключи.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has found): at last, результат важен сейчас — ключи найдены.

notes.en: He answered the last question and smiled.
notes.ru: Он ответил на последний вопрос и улыбнулся.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): два последовательных завершённых действия в прошлом.

notes.en: That’s enough for today. He has done his best.
notes.ru: На сегодня хватит. Он сделал всё, что мог.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has done): результат важен сейчас — он сделал всё возможное.

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в Present Perfect, Past Simple, Past Continuous или Past Perfect.
items: Last winter we {|to stay|DP} in the mountains and {|to go|DP} skiing every day.
My brother {|to save|X3/D} enough money and {|to buy|D3} a new laptop last month.
By the end of the week all the reports {|to be|XP} ready.
Newton {|to discover|D3} the law of gravity centuries ago.
He {|not to realize|D3} that he {|to make|X3} a serious mistake.
I {already|to watch|H1} five episodes of this series.
They {|to discuss|XP/D} the project with the manager before they {|to start|DP} work.
Mother {|to bake|H3} an apple pie — it smells delicious!
She {|to read|W3} an English article the whole evening yesterday.
I {never|to travel|H1} abroad before.
They {|to tell|DP} me that you {|to receive|XP} the invitation already.
When I {|to arrive|D1} home, my sister {already|to cook|X3} dinner.
Look! What a nice car he {|to buy|H3}!
They {|to drive|WP} along the coast when the storm {|to begin|D3}.
We {|not to see|HP} each other for months.
They {|to eat|DP/H} all the cookies which I {|to bake|X1/D} yesterday.
When I {|to come|D1} to the office, the meeting {already|to start|X3}.
{You ever|to be|HP} to the Eiffel Tower?
At this time yesterday he {|to paint|W3} the walls in his room.
My friend {|to call|D3} me from Berlin an hour ago.
When I {|to get|D1} home, my father {|to repair|W3} his car in the garage.
I {|to promise|D1/H} to visit her before Sunday.

notes.en: Last winter we stayed in the mountains and went skiing every day.
notes.ru: Прошлой зимой мы жили в горах и каждый день катались на лыжах.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): last winter — завершённый период в прошлом.

notes.en: My brother had saved enough money and bought a new laptop last month.
notes.ru: Мой брат накопил достаточно денег и в прошлом месяце купил новый ноутбук.
notes.why: Bought — Past Simple (last month); накопил раньше — Past Perfect (had saved), допустим и Past Simple.

notes.en: By the end of the week all the reports had been ready.
notes.ru: К концу недели все отчёты были готовы.
notes.why: Past Perfect (had been): by the end of the week — состояние к моменту в прошлом.

notes.en: Newton discovered the law of gravity centuries ago.
notes.ru: Ньютон открыл закон всемирного тяготения столетия назад.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): centuries ago — конкретное время в прошлом.

notes.en: He did not realize that he had made a serious mistake.
notes.ru: Он не осознавал, что совершил серьёзную ошибку.
notes.why: Did not realize — Past Simple; ошибка раньше момента осознания — Past Perfect (had made).

notes.en: I have already watched five episodes of this series.
notes.ru: Я уже посмотрел пять серий этого сериала.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have watched): already — результат к настоящему моменту.

notes.en: They had discussed the project with the manager before they started work.
notes.ru: Они обсудили проект с менеджером до того, как приступили к работе.
notes.why: Started — Past Simple; обсуждение раньше, before — Past Perfect (had discussed), допустим и Past Simple.

notes.en: Mother has baked an apple pie — it smells delicious!
notes.ru: Мама испекла яблочный пирог — он восхитительно пахнет!
notes.why: Present Perfect (has baked): результат виден сейчас — запах пирога.

notes.en: She was reading an English article the whole evening yesterday.
notes.ru: Вчера она читала английскую статью весь вечер.
notes.why: Past Continuous (was reading): the whole evening yesterday — длительное действие.

notes.en: I have never travelled abroad before.
notes.ru: Я никогда раньше не бывал за границей.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have never travelled): опыт жизни до сих пор, never.

notes.en: They told me that you had received the invitation already.
notes.ru: Они сказали мне, что ты уже получил приглашение.
notes.why: Told — Past Simple; получение раньше, already — Past Perfect (had received).

notes.en: When I arrived home, my sister had already cooked dinner.
notes.ru: Когда я пришёл домой, сестра уже приготовила ужин.
notes.why: Arrived — Past Simple; ужин приготовлен раньше, already — Past Perfect (had cooked).

notes.en: Look! What a nice car he has bought!
notes.ru: Смотри! Какую красивую машину он купил!
notes.why: Present Perfect (has bought): Look! — результат виден сейчас.

notes.en: They were driving along the coast when the storm began.
notes.ru: Они ехали вдоль побережья, когда началась буря.
notes.why: Длительное действие — Past Continuous (were driving); его прервало короткое — Past Simple (began).

notes.en: We have not seen each other for months.
notes.ru: Мы не виделись несколько месяцев.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have not seen): for months — период до настоящего момента.

notes.en: They ate all the cookies which I had baked yesterday.
notes.ru: Они съели все печенья, которые я испёк вчера.
notes.why: Ate — Past Simple (или have eaten); испечено раньше — Past Perfect (had baked), допустим и Past Simple с yesterday.

notes.en: When I came to the office, the meeting had already started.
notes.ru: Когда я пришёл в офис, совещание уже началось.
notes.why: Came — Past Simple; начало раньше, already — Past Perfect (had started).

notes.en: Have you ever been to the Eiffel Tower?
notes.ru: Ты когда-нибудь был на Эйфелевой башне?
notes.why: Present Perfect (have you ever been): вопрос об опыте жизни, ever.

notes.en: At this time yesterday he was painting the walls in his room.
notes.ru: Вчера в это время он красил стены в своей комнате.
notes.why: Past Continuous (was painting): At this time yesterday — процесс в конкретный момент.

notes.en: My friend called me from Berlin an hour ago.
notes.ru: Мой друг позвонил мне из Берлина час назад.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): an hour ago — конкретное время в прошлом.

notes.en: When I got home, my father was repairing his car in the garage.
notes.ru: Когда я пришёл домой, отец чинил машину в гараже.
notes.why: Got — Past Simple; was repairing — процесс в момент прихода, Past Continuous.

notes.en: I promised to visit her before Sunday.
notes.ru: Я пообещал навестить её до воскресенья.
notes.why: Promised — Past Simple: обещание дано в прошлом; Present Perfect (have promised) — с акцентом на результат сейчас.

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в Present Perfect, Past Simple, Past Continuous или Past Perfect.
items: She is very proud: her daughter {|to graduate|H3} from university.
My brother {|to jog|W3} in the park from six till seven yesterday.
My mother {|to buy|H3} a new smartphone this week.
I {|not to watch|H1} TV for several days.
When Paul {|to come|D3} home, his friends {|to play|WP} chess in the living room.
When {your parents|to go|DP} to Italy?
My uncle {just|to recover|H3} after the operation.
I {never|to be|H1} to Canada.
At this time yesterday we {|to discuss|WP} our travel plans.
I {|to write|D1} to my teacher yesterday.
Look! Mary {|to clean|H3} the windows.
{Your father|to return|H3} from the office? Can I speak to him?
She {|to redecorate|W3} her room the whole day on Sunday.
The dog {|to eat|D3/H} all the food which I {|to put|X1/D} in the bowl.
{You ever|to be|HP} to the Louvre?
He {|not to read|H3} Shakespeare since he was a student.
They {|to reach|DP/X} the station before sunset.
I {|not yet to receive|=have not yet received} your message.

We {already|to study|HP} eight grammar topics.
He {|to spend|D3} three months in Japan last year.
I {|to buy|H1} a stylish coat. Now I can wear it to the event.
He {|to learn|X3} Spanish before he {|to move|D3} to Spain.
When she {|to lose|D3} her purse, she {|to cry|D3} a lot.

notes.en: She is very proud: her daughter has graduated from university.
notes.ru: Она очень гордится: её дочь окончила университет.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has graduated): результат важен сейчас — мать гордится.

notes.en: My brother was jogging in the park from six till seven yesterday.
notes.ru: Вчера мой брат бегал в парке с шести до семи.
notes.why: Past Continuous (was jogging): from six till seven yesterday — длительное действие.

notes.en: My mother has bought a new smartphone this week.
notes.ru: Моя мама купила новый смартфон на этой неделе.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has bought): this week — период ещё не закончен.

notes.en: I have not watched TV for several days.
notes.ru: Я не смотрел телевизор несколько дней.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have not watched): for several days — период до настоящего момента.

notes.en: When Paul came home, his friends were playing chess in the living room.
notes.ru: Когда Пол пришёл домой, его друзья играли в шахматы в гостиной.
notes.why: Came — Past Simple; were playing — процесс в тот момент, Past Continuous.

notes.en: When did your parents go to Italy?
notes.ru: Когда твои родители ездили в Италию?
notes.why: Past Simple (did ... go): вопрос с when о конкретном времени в прошлом.

notes.en: My uncle has just recovered after the operation.
notes.ru: Мой дядя только что оправился после операции.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has just recovered): just — недавнее действие с результатом сейчас.

notes.en: I have never been to Canada.
notes.ru: Я никогда не был в Канаде.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have never been): жизненный опыт, never.

notes.en: At this time yesterday we were discussing our travel plans.
notes.ru: Вчера в это время мы обсуждали планы поездки.
notes.why: Past Continuous (were discussing): At this time yesterday — процесс в конкретный момент.

notes.en: I wrote to my teacher yesterday.
notes.ru: Вчера я написал своему учителю.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): yesterday — конкретное время в прошлом.

notes.en: Look! Mary has cleaned the windows.
notes.ru: Смотри! Мэри вымыла окна.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has cleaned): Look! — результат виден сейчас.

notes.en: Has your father returned from the office? Can I speak to him?
notes.ru: Твой отец вернулся с работы? Можно с ним поговорить?
notes.why: Present Perfect (has returned): важен результат сейчас — можно ли поговорить с ним.

notes.en: She was redecorating her room the whole day on Sunday.
notes.ru: В воскресенье она весь день делала ремонт в своей комнате.
notes.why: Past Continuous (was redecorating): the whole day on Sunday — длительное действие.

notes.en: The dog ate all the food which I had put in the bowl.
notes.ru: Собака съела всю еду, которую я положил в миску.
notes.why: Ate — Past Simple; положил раньше — Past Perfect (had put), допустим и Past Simple.

notes.en: Have you ever been to the Louvre?
notes.ru: Ты когда-нибудь был в Лувре?
notes.why: Present Perfect (have you ever been): вопрос об опыте жизни, ever.

notes.en: He has not read Shakespeare since he was a student.
notes.ru: Он не читал Шекспира с тех пор, как был студентом.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has not read): since + момент в прошлом — период до настоящего.

notes.en: They reached the station before sunset.
notes.ru: Они добрались до станции до заката.
notes.why: Past Simple (reached): before sunset — действие в прошлом; допустим и Past Perfect.

notes.en: I have not yet received your message.
notes.ru: Я ещё не получил твоё сообщение.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have not yet received): yet — до настоящего момента ещё не произошло.

notes.en: While she was preparing dinner, she suddenly remembered her appointment.
notes.ru: Пока она готовила ужин, она вдруг вспомнила о встрече.
notes.why: Длительное действие — Past Continuous (was preparing); его прервало короткое — Past Simple (remembered).

notes.en: We have already studied eight grammar topics.
notes.ru: Мы уже изучили восемь грамматических тем.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have studied): already — результат к настоящему моменту.

notes.en: He spent three months in Japan last year.
notes.ru: В прошлом году он провёл три месяца в Японии.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): last year — завершённый период в прошлом.

notes.en: I have bought a stylish coat. Now I can wear it to the event.
notes.ru: Я купила стильное пальто. Теперь могу надеть его на мероприятие.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have bought): результат важен сейчас — теперь можно надеть.

notes.en: He had learned Spanish before he moved to Spain.
notes.ru: Он выучил испанский до того, как переехал в Испанию.
notes.why: Moved — Past Simple; изучение раньше, before — Past Perfect (had learned).

notes.en: When she lost her purse, she cried a lot.
notes.ru: Когда она потеряла кошелёк, она много плакала.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): два последовательных события в прошлом — lost, cried.

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в одном из времён: Present Simple, Past Simple, Future Simple, Present Continuous, Past Continuous, Present Perfect, Past Perfect.
items: My sister {|to love|S3} chocolate. She {|to eat|S3} a few pieces every evening. When I {|to see|D1} her in the park yesterday, she {|to eat|W3} an ice cream. She {|to tell|D3} me that she {|to buy|X3} it at the new café nearby. Look at her now! She {|to eat|C3} another one!
I usually {|to leave|S1} for work at eight o’clock. Yesterday I {|to leave|D1} at half past eight because it {|to rain|W3/D}. Tomorrow I {|to leave|F1} earlier to catch the bus.
He {already|to finish|H3} his report this week. Yesterday he {|to stay|D3} at home and {|to read|D3/W} all day.
What {your parents|to do|CP} now? They {|to work|CP} in the garden.
My mother {|to work|S3} in a hospital. It {|to be|S3} Monday now. She {|not to work|C3} today; she {|to rest|C3} at home.
I {|not to see|H1} my teacher for a while. He {|to be|S3} on vacation. I {|to have|H1} many new lessons since he left.
What {you|to do|WP} at nine o’clock last night? — I {|not to watch|W1} TV; I {|to read|W1} a book.
They {|to have|CP} a difficult time at the moment. I {|to be|S1} sure they will manage soon.
The baby {|to sleep|W3} when suddenly the door {|to open|D3}.
She {|to lose|D3} her phone yesterday. She {|to ask|D3} me if I {|to see|X1} it.
The boys {|to finish|HP} all the homework; now they {|to play|CP} football in the yard.
When she {|to arrive|D3} home, her brother {already|to cook|X3} dinner.

notes.en: My sister loves chocolate. She eats a few pieces every evening. When I saw her in the park yesterday, she was eating an ice cream. She told me that she had bought it at the new café nearby. Look at her now! She is eating another one!
notes.ru: Моя сестра любит шоколад. Она съедает несколько кусочков каждый вечер. Когда я вчера увидел её в парке, она ела мороженое. Она сказала, что купила его в новом кафе неподалёку. Посмотри на неё сейчас! Она ест ещё одно!
notes.why: Loves, eats — Present Simple (привычка, every evening); saw, told — Past Simple; was eating — процесс; had bought — раньше; is eating — Look, now.

notes.en: I usually leave for work at eight o’clock. Yesterday I left at half past eight because it was raining. Tomorrow I will leave earlier to catch the bus.
notes.ru: Я обычно ухожу на работу в восемь часов. Вчера я ушёл в половине девятого, потому что шёл дождь. Завтра я уйду раньше, чтобы успеть на автобус.
notes.why: Usually — Present Simple (leave); yesterday — Past Simple (left, was raining/rained); tomorrow — Future Simple (will leave).

notes.en: He has already finished his report this week. Yesterday he stayed at home and read all day.
notes.ru: На этой неделе он уже закончил свой отчёт. Вчера он остался дома и весь день читал.
notes.why: Has already finished — Present Perfect (this week, already); stayed — Past Simple (yesterday); read/was reading — all day.

notes.en: What are your parents doing now? They are working in the garden.
notes.ru: Что делают твои родители сейчас? Они работают в саду.
notes.why: Now — Present Continuous (are doing, are working): действие происходит в момент речи.

notes.en: My mother works in a hospital. It is Monday now. She is not working today; she is resting at home.
notes.ru: Моя мама работает в больнице. Сейчас понедельник. Сегодня она не работает, она отдыхает дома.
notes.why: Works — Present Simple (постоянное); is — состояние; today и сейчас — Present Continuous (is not working, is resting).

notes.en: I have not seen my teacher for a while. He is on vacation. I have had many new lessons since he left.
notes.ru: Я давно не видел своего учителя. Он в отпуске. У меня было много новых уроков с тех пор, как он уехал.
notes.why: For a while и since — Present Perfect (have not seen, have had); is — Present Simple, состояние сейчас.

notes.en: What were you doing at nine o’clock last night? — I was not watching TV; I was reading a book.
notes.ru: Что ты делал вчера в девять часов вечера? — Я не смотрел телевизор, я читал книгу.
notes.why: At nine o’clock last night — процесс в конкретный момент прошлого: Past Continuous (was/were + Ving).

notes.en: They are having a difficult time at the moment. I am sure they will manage soon.
notes.ru: У них сейчас трудное время. Я уверен, что скоро они справятся.
notes.why: At the moment — Present Continuous (are having); am — Present Simple, состояние (sure).

notes.en: The baby was sleeping when suddenly the door opened.
notes.ru: Малыш спал, когда вдруг открылась дверь.
notes.why: Длительное действие — Past Continuous (was sleeping); его прервало короткое — Past Simple (opened).

notes.en: She lost her phone yesterday. She asked me if I had seen it.
notes.ru: Вчера она потеряла телефон. Она спросила меня, не видел ли я его.
notes.why: Yesterday — Past Simple (lost, asked); видел раньше вопроса — Past Perfect (had seen).

notes.en: The boys have finished all the homework; now they are playing football in the yard.
notes.ru: Мальчики сделали все домашние задания; сейчас они играют во дворе в футбол.
notes.why: Have finished — Present Perfect, результат сейчас; now — Present Continuous (are playing).

notes.en: When she arrived home, her brother had already cooked dinner.
notes.ru: Когда она пришла домой, её брат уже приготовил ужин.
notes.why: Arrived — Past Simple; ужин приготовлен раньше, already — Past Perfect (had cooked).

notes.en: We have picked a basket of apples from the garden. Now we are planning to bake an apple pie.
notes.ru: Мы набрали корзину яблок в саду. Теперь мы собираемся испечь яблочный пирог.
notes.why: Have picked — Present Perfect, результат важен сейчас; now — Present Continuous (are planning).

notes.en: Look! Jane is riding her bike along the road.
notes.ru: Смотри! Джейн едет на велосипеде по дороге.
notes.why: Present Continuous (is riding): Look! — действие происходит прямо сейчас.

notes.en: What were your friends doing at ten o’clock yesterday?
notes.ru: Что делали твои друзья вчера в десять часов?
notes.why: Past Continuous (were doing): at ten o’clock yesterday — процесс в конкретный момент.

notes.en: Have you ever visited the Eiffel Tower?
notes.ru: Ты когда-нибудь был на Эйфелевой башне?
notes.why: Present Perfect (have you ever visited): вопрос об опыте жизни, ever.

notes.en: I travelled to Italy two years ago.
notes.ru: Я ездил в Италию два года назад.
notes.why: Past Simple (V2): two years ago — конкретное время в прошлом.

notes.en: We have studied English for three years already.
notes.ru: Мы уже три года изучаем английский.
notes.why: Present Perfect (have studied): for three years already — период до настоящего момента.

notes.en: Anna had completed her project by eight o’clock yesterday.
notes.ru: К восьми часам вчера Анна завершила свой проект.
notes.why: Past Perfect (had completed): by eight o’clock yesterday — завершено к моменту в прошлом.

notes.en: Will you call your teacher tomorrow?
notes.ru: Ты позвонишь завтра своему учителю?
notes.why: Future Simple (will + V): tomorrow — действие в будущем.

notes.en: When Peter returned home yesterday, his parents had come back from the market and were preparing dinner.
notes.ru: Когда Питер вчера вернулся домой, его родители уже вернулись с рынка и готовили ужин.
notes.why: Returned — Past Simple; вернулись раньше — Past Perfect (had come); готовили в момент — Past Continuous (were preparing).

notes.en: When I entered the classroom yesterday, I suddenly realized that I had forgotten my notebook.
notes.ru: Когда я вчера вошёл в класс, я вдруг понял, что забыл тетрадь.
notes.why: Entered, realized — Past Simple; забыл раньше момента осознания — Past Perfect (had forgotten).

notes.en: Yesterday my grandmother told us how she lived in a small village during her childhood.
notes.ru: Вчера бабушка рассказала нам, как жила в маленькой деревне в детстве.
notes.why: Told — Past Simple; жизнь в детстве раньше — Past Perfect (had lived), допустим и Past Simple.

notes.en: When Mr. and Mrs. Brown arrived home, they discovered that their cat had climbed onto the roof.
notes.ru: Когда мистер и миссис Браун пришли домой, они обнаружили, что их кот забрался на крышу.
notes.why: Arrived, discovered — Past Simple; кот забрался раньше — Past Perfect (had climbed).

notes.en: They did not understand what had happened, because their phone had stopped working.
notes.ru: Они не поняли, что случилось, потому что их телефон перестал работать.
notes.why: Did not understand — Past Simple; происшествие и остановка раньше — Past Perfect (had happened, had stopped).

notes.en: The boy jumped off the bus while the driver was checking the tickets.
notes.ru: Мальчик выпрыгнул из автобуса, пока водитель проверял билеты.
notes.why: Короткое действие — Past Simple (jumped); while — длительное одновременное: Past Continuous (was checking).

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в одном из времён: Present Simple, Past Simple, Future Simple, Present Continuous, Past Continuous, Present Perfect, Past Perfect.

If you {|to call|SP} me now, I {|to join|F1} you for a walk.

What {you|to watch|CP} now? — I {|to watch|C1} a documentary.
I {|to hurry|C1}. Mum {soon|to return|F3}, and I {|to need|S1} to tidy up before she {|to arrive|S3}.
As soon as you {|to meet|SP} your brother, tell him that I {|to wait|C1} for him.
When I {|to come|D1} home yesterday, my sister {|to cook|W3}.
When {you|to plan|CP} to visit us? — I {|to come|F1/C} next week if I {|not to be|S1} busy.
I {|not to eat|S1} chocolate.
He {|to leave|D3} the office at six yesterday.
I {|to text|F1} you as soon as I {|to finish|S1} the report.

This little guy {never|to see|H3} a giraffe.
Send me a message as soon as you {|to arrive|SP}.
We {|to know|DP/X} the answer before they {|to announce|DP} it.
{You|to hear|HP} the latest update?

notes.en: Let’s visit the park. The wind has stopped.
notes.ru: Давай сходим в парк. Ветер стих.
notes.why: Present Perfect (has + V3): результат важен сейчас — ветер уже стих, поэтому можно идти гулять.

notes.en: If you call me now, I will join you for a walk.
notes.ru: Если ты позвонишь мне сейчас, я присоединюсь к тебе на прогулке.
notes.why: В условии после if — Present Simple (call), в главной части — Future Simple (will join): будущее следствие.

notes.en: I usually leave home at seven, but tomorrow I will leave at half past six.
notes.ru: Я обычно ухожу из дома в семь, но завтра уйду в половине седьмого.
notes.why: Usually — привычка, Present Simple (leave). Tomorrow — будущее: Future Simple (will leave) или Present Continuous (am leaving) для плана.

notes.en: What are you watching now? — I am watching a documentary.
notes.ru: Что ты смотришь сейчас? — Я смотрю документальный фильм.
notes.why: Маркер now — действие происходит в момент речи: Present Continuous (am/are + Ving) в вопросе и ответе.

notes.en: I am hurrying. Mum will soon return, and I need to tidy up before she arrives.
notes.ru: Я спешу. Мама скоро вернётся, а мне нужно убраться до того, как она придёт.
notes.why: Am hurrying — Present Continuous, действие сейчас. Will soon return — Future Simple. Need — Present Simple (глагол состояния), arrives — Present Simple после before.

notes.en: As soon as you meet your brother, tell him that I am waiting for him.
notes.ru: Как только встретишь брата, скажи ему, что я его жду.
notes.why: После as soon as о будущем — Present Simple (meet). Am waiting — Present Continuous: ожидание длится в момент речи.

notes.en: When I came home yesterday, my sister was cooking.
notes.ru: Когда я вчера пришёл домой, моя сестра готовила.
notes.why: Yesterday — Past Simple (came) для короткого действия; Past Continuous (was cooking) — длительное действие, шедшее в тот момент.

notes.en: When are you planning to visit us? — I will come next week if I am not busy.
notes.ru: Когда ты планируешь навестить нас? — Я приду на следующей неделе, если не буду занят.
notes.why: Are you planning — Present Continuous о планах. Next week — будущее: will come или am coming. После if — Present Simple (am not).

notes.en: I do not eat chocolate.
notes.ru: Я не ем шоколад.
notes.why: Общий факт о привычке — Present Simple; отрицание: do not + V1.

notes.en: He left the office at six yesterday.
notes.ru: Вчера в шесть он ушёл из офиса.
notes.why: Yesterday и точное время — законченное действие в прошлом: Past Simple (left, V2).

notes.en: I will text you as soon as I finish the report.
notes.ru: Я напишу тебе, как только закончу отчёт.
notes.why: Главная часть — Future Simple (will text); после as soon as о будущем — Present Simple (finish).

notes.en: If you explain the rules to me, I will understand everything faster.
notes.ru: Если ты объяснишь мне правила, я быстрее всё пойму.
notes.why: После if — Present Simple (explain), в главной части — Future Simple (will understand): условие и результат.

notes.en: He had got home by nine yesterday.
notes.ru: К девяти вчера он уже был дома.
notes.why: By nine yesterday — действие завершилось к моменту в прошлом: Past Perfect (had + V3).

notes.en: This little guy has never seen a giraffe.
notes.ru: Этот малыш никогда не видел жирафа.
notes.why: Never и опыт до настоящего момента — Present Perfect (has + V3).

notes.en: Send me a message as soon as you arrive.
notes.ru: Пришли мне сообщение, как только приедешь.
notes.why: После as soon as о будущем действии употребляется Present Simple (arrive), а не will.

notes.en: We knew the answer before they announced it.
notes.ru: Мы знали ответ ещё до того, как они его объявили.
notes.why: Before и второе действие в Past Simple (announced); знание было раньше — Past Simple (knew) или Past Perfect (had known).

notes.en: Have you heard the latest update?
notes.ru: Ты слышал последние новости?
notes.why: Вопрос о недавнем событии с важным результатом сейчас — Present Perfect (have + V3), вопросительный порядок: have you heard.

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в одном из времён: Present Simple, Past Simple, Future Simple, Present Continuous, Past Continuous, Present Perfect, Past Perfect.
items: Yesterday I {|to leave|D1} a note on the kitchen table. Where {it|to be|S3} now? — I {|to throw|D1/H} it away. {You|to write|FP} another one tomorrow? — Yes, if I {|not to forget|S1} before I {|to go|S1} to bed.
{You ever|to try|HP} Turkish coffee?

Why {he|to run|C3} now? It {|to be|S3} too cold outside. He never {|to jog|S3} in this weather.
{You|to visit|FP/C} the new bookstore tomorrow? — No, I {already|to be|H1} there this week. I {|to go|D1} there on Tuesday.

notes.en: Yesterday I left a note on the kitchen table. Where is it now? — I threw it away. will you write another one tomorrow? — Yes, if I do not forget before I go to bed.
notes.ru: Вчера я оставил записку на кухонном столе. Где она сейчас? — Я её выбросил. Ты завтра напишешь другую? — Да, если не забуду до того, как лягу спать.
notes.why: Yesterday — Past Simple (left); now — Present Simple (is); выбросил — Past Simple или Present Perfect; tomorrow — Future Simple (will you write). После if и before — Present Simple (do not forget, go).

notes.en: Have you ever tried Turkish coffee?
notes.ru: Ты когда-нибудь пробовал турецкий кофе?
notes.why: Ever и вопрос об опыте в жизни — Present Perfect (have you ever tried).

notes.en: What was Anna doing when you called her yesterday? — She was practicing the violin. She told me that she had already learned two new pieces.
notes.ru: Что делала Анна, когда ты вчера ей позвонил? — Она играла на скрипке. Она сказала мне, что уже выучила две новые пьесы.
notes.why: Длительное действие в момент звонка — Past Continuous (was doing, was practicing), короткое — Past Simple (called, told). Выучила до рассказа — Past Perfect (had learned).

notes.en: Why is he running now? It is too cold outside. He never jogs in this weather.
notes.ru: Почему он сейчас бежит? На улице слишком холодно. Он никогда не бегает в такую погоду.
notes.why: Now — Present Continuous (is running). Is — Present Simple, глагол состояния. Never jogs — привычка, Present Simple; после he — окончание -s.

notes.en: Will you visit the new bookstore tomorrow? — No, I have already been there this week. I went there on Tuesday.
notes.ru: Ты завтра пойдёшь в новый книжный магазин? — Нет, я уже был там на этой неделе. Я ходил туда во вторник.
notes.why: Tomorrow — будущее: will you visit или are you visiting. Already и this week — Present Perfect (have been). On Tuesday — Past Simple (went).

notes.en: As a rule, I pick up parcels from the post office every Friday. But yesterday I did not go there, because I was waiting for a courier delivery.
notes.ru: Как правило, я забираю посылки на почте каждую пятницу. Но вчера я туда не ходил, потому что ждал доставку курьером.
notes.why: As a rule, every Friday — привычка, Present Simple (pick up). Yesterday — Past Simple (did not go); ожидание длилось — Past Continuous (was waiting).

notes.en: I will go to the dentist on Monday if I finish my project by Sunday.
notes.ru: Я пойду к стоматологу в понедельник, если закончу проект к воскресенью.
notes.why: Главная часть о будущем — Future Simple (will go); после if — Present Simple (finish).

notes.en: As soon as we receive confirmation of our booking, I will pack my suitcase.
notes.ru: Как только мы получим подтверждение бронирования, я соберу чемодан.
notes.why: После as soon as о будущем — Present Simple (receive); в главной части — Future Simple (will pack).

notes.en: By eight o’clock we had already reserved the tickets.
notes.ru: К восьми часам мы уже забронировали билеты.
notes.why: By eight o'clock и already — действие завершилось до момента в прошлом: Past Perfect (had reserved).

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в одном из времён: Present Simple, Past Simple, Future Simple, Present Continuous, Past Continuous, Present Perfect, Past Perfect.
items: Winter {|to come|H3/C}. It {|to be|S3} December now. It {|to get|C3} darker, the evenings {|to become|CP} longer. It often {|to snow|S3}. Soon it {|to be|F3} very cold.
When I {|to clean|W1} my room yesterday, I quickly {|to run|D1} to the shop because my mum {|to wait|W3} for me there.
We {|to have|DP} a great trip last spring.
What {you|to plan|CP} for today? — I {|to be|S1} very tired, I {|not to want|S1} to do anything.
I {|to be|D1} ill yesterday and {|not to know|D1} what to do.
What {you|to do|WP} at seven o’clock yesterday evening?
Emma always {|to finish|S3} her chores in the afternoon, but tomorrow she {|to start|F3/C} earlier because her sister {|to promise|H3} to help her.

notes.en: Winter has come. It is December now. It is getting darker, the evenings are becoming longer. It often snows. Soon it will be very cold.
notes.ru: Пришла зима. Сейчас декабрь. Становится темнее, вечера становятся длиннее. Часто идёт снег. Скоро будет очень холодно.
notes.why: Now и процесс — Present Continuous (is getting, are becoming). Is и often snows — Present Simple (состояние, повторяемость). Soon — Future Simple (will be). Has come или is coming — смена сезона.

notes.en: When I was cleaning my room yesterday, I quickly ran to the shop because my mum was waiting for me there.
notes.ru: Когда вчера я убирался в комнате, я быстро сбегал в магазин, потому что там меня ждала мама.
notes.why: Длительный фон в прошлом — Past Continuous (was cleaning, was waiting); короткое действие — Past Simple (ran).

notes.en: We had a great trip last spring.
notes.ru: Прошлой весной у нас была отличная поездка.
notes.why: Last spring — законченное время в прошлом: Past Simple (had, V2).

notes.en: What are you planning for today? — I am very tired, I do not want to do anything.
notes.ru: Что ты планируешь на сегодня? — Я очень устал, ничего не хочу делать.
notes.why: Today — Present Continuous о планах (are you planning). Am и do not want — Present Simple: состояние и нежелание сейчас.

notes.en: I was ill yesterday and did not know what to do.
notes.ru: Вчера я был болен и не знал, что делать.
notes.why: Yesterday — Past Simple: was (V2 от be) и did not know (did not + V1).

notes.en: What were you doing at seven o’clock yesterday evening?
notes.ru: Что ты делал вчера в семь часов вечера?
notes.why: Конкретный момент в прошлом — Past Continuous (were you doing): действие было в процессе.

notes.en: Emma always finishes her chores in the afternoon, but tomorrow she will start earlier because her sister has promised to help her.
notes.ru: Эмма всегда заканчивает домашние дела днём, но завтра начнёт раньше, потому что сестра пообещала ей помочь.
notes.why: Always — Present Simple (finishes). Tomorrow — will start или is starting (план). Обещание уже дано, результат важен — Present Perfect (has promised).

notes.en: When Kevin returned home, his brother was reading the comic book which he had borrowed from him two days earlier.
notes.ru: Когда Кевин вернулся домой, его брат читал комикс, который взял у него два дня назад.
notes.why: Returned — Past Simple; was reading — Past Continuous, процесс в тот момент; had borrowed — Past Perfect, действие раньше (two days earlier).

exercises.task: Раскройте скобки, употребляя глаголы в указанном времени Passive Voice.
items: The documents {|to send|=will be sent} tomorrow morning. (Future Simple Passive)
This bridge {|to build|=was built} in 1998. (Past Simple Passive)
The room {|to clean|=is being cleaned} now. (Present Continuous Passive)
Many languages {|to speak|=are spoken} in this country. (Present Simple Passive)
Her laptop {|to repair|=was repaired} by the technician yesterday. (Past Simple Passive)
The report {|to finish|=will have been finished} by 6 p.m. (Future Perfect Passive)
Our project {|to check|=has been checked} already. (Present Perfect Passive)
The homework {|to give|=is given} to students every Monday. (Present Simple Passive)
The problem {|to discuss|=was discussed} at the meeting yesterday. (Past Simple Passive)
A new hospital {|to build|=is being built} in this area now. (Present Continuous Passive)
All the invitations {|to send|=had been sent} before noon yesterday. (Past Perfect Passive)
A special award {|to present|=will be presented} to her next week. (Future Simple Passive)
The results {|to publish|=will have been published} by the end of the year. (Future Perfect Passive)
The flowers {|to water|=are watered} every evening. (Present Simple Passive)
The letter {|to translate|=was being translated} when I last checked. (Past Continuous Passive)
This song {|to write|=is written|was written} by a famous composer. (Present Simple Passive)
The museum {|to visit|=is visited} by thousands of tourists each year. (Present Simple Passive)
The room {|to decorate|=had been decorated} by the time they arrived. (Past Perfect Passive)
{||=Has} my application {|to approve|=been approved} yet? (Present Perfect Passive)

notes.en: The documents will be sent tomorrow morning. (Future Simple Passive)
notes.ru: Документы будут отправлены завтра утром.
notes.why: Future Simple Passive: will be + V3. Tomorrow morning указывает на будущее.

notes.en: This bridge was built in 1998. (Past Simple Passive)
notes.ru: Этот мост был построен в 1998 году.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3. Год 1998 — законченное время в прошлом.

notes.en: The room is being cleaned now. (Present Continuous Passive)
notes.ru: Комнату сейчас убирают.
notes.why: Present Continuous Passive: am/is/are being + V3. Now — действие идёт сейчас.

notes.en: Many languages are spoken in this country. (Present Simple Passive)
notes.ru: В этой стране говорят на многих языках.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive: am/is/are + V3. Many languages — множественное число, поэтому are spoken.

notes.en: Her laptop was repaired by the technician yesterday. (Past Simple Passive)
notes.ru: Её ноутбук вчера починил техник.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3. Yesterday — прошлое, laptop — единственное число; исполнитель указан через by.

notes.en: The report will have been finished by 6 p.m. (Future Perfect Passive)
notes.ru: Отчёт будет закончен к 18:00.
notes.why: Future Perfect Passive: will have been + V3. By 6 p.m. — действие завершится к моменту в будущем.

notes.en: Our project has been checked already. (Present Perfect Passive)
notes.ru: Наш проект уже проверен.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: has/have been + V3. Already — результат важен сейчас; project — единственное число, поэтому has.

notes.en: The homework is given to students every Monday. (Present Simple Passive)
notes.ru: Домашнее задание задают ученикам каждый понедельник.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive: is + V3. Every Monday — регулярность; homework — неисчисляемое, поэтому is.

notes.en: The problem was discussed at the meeting yesterday. (Past Simple Passive)
notes.ru: Проблему обсудили на встрече вчера.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3. Yesterday — законченное время в прошлом.

notes.en: A new hospital is being built in this area now. (Present Continuous Passive)
notes.ru: В этом районе сейчас строят новую больницу.
notes.why: Present Continuous Passive: is being + V3. Now — действие идёт сейчас; hospital — единственное число.

notes.en: All the invitations had been sent before noon yesterday. (Past Perfect Passive)

exercises.task: Переведите следующие предложения в Passive Voice. Пиши предложение целиком.
items:
I cleaned my room yesterday.
→ {||=My room was cleaned yesterday.}

They will deliver the furniture tomorrow.
→ {||=The furniture will be delivered tomorrow.}

We sell fresh vegetables in this market.
→ {||=Fresh vegetables are sold in this market.}

She has written three scientific articles.

Someone stole his bicycle last week.
→ {||=His bicycle was stolen last week.}

By ten o’clock they had closed the shop.

At five o’clock the teachers were checking the tests.

By noon the workers had repaired the bridge.
→ {||=By noon the bridge had been repaired by the workers.|By noon the bridge had been repaired.|The bridge had been repaired by noon.}

He teaches mathematics at the local school.
→ {||=Mathematics is taught at the local school.}

They will broadcast this documentary tomorrow.
→ {||=This documentary will be broadcast tomorrow.|This documentary will be broadcasted tomorrow.}

They are constructing a new stadium in our city.
→ {||=A new stadium is being constructed in our city.}

The students broke the projector yesterday.
→ {||=The projector was broken by the students yesterday.|The projector was broken yesterday.}

When I entered the office, they had already finished the meeting.

They will announce the results in the evening.

notes.en: The furniture will be delivered tomorrow.

exercises.task: Передайте следующие предложения в Passive Voice. Пиши предложение целиком.
items:
They grow vegetables in my grandmother’s village.
→ {||=Vegetables are grown in my grandmother’s village.}

We heard this strange noise at midnight.
→ {||=This strange noise was heard at midnight.}

Has the dog ever bitten you?
→ {||=Have you ever been bitten by the dog?}

Birds build their nests in the tall trees.
→ {||=Nests are built by birds in the tall trees.|The nests are built by birds in the tall trees.|Their nests are built in the tall trees by birds.|Nests are built in the tall trees by birds.|Nests are built in the tall trees.}

The wind blew my hat into the river.
→ {||=My hat was blown into the river by the wind.|My hat was blown into the river.}

Who wrote this beautiful song?
→ {||=Who was this beautiful song written by?|By whom was this beautiful song written?}

They are selling fresh bread at the market today.
→ {||=Fresh bread is being sold at the market today.}

The old woman showed us the shortest way home.
→ {||=We were shown the shortest way home by the old woman.|We were shown the shortest way home.|The shortest way home was shown to us by the old woman.|The shortest way home was shown to us.}

They offered him a place in the new project.
→ {||=He was offered a place in the new project.|A place in the new project was offered to him.}

The doctor recommended this diet to my father.
→ {||=This diet was recommended to my father by the doctor.|This diet was recommended to my father.|My father was recommended this diet by the doctor.}

People don’t use this machine anymore.
→ {||=This machine is not used anymore.}

Everybody admired the painting at the exhibition.
→ {||=The painting was admired by everybody at the exhibition.|The painting was admired at the exhibition by everybody.|The painting was admired at the exhibition.}

They have been waiting for you since early morning.
→ {||=You have been waited for since early morning.}

We shall follow these instructions strictly.
→ {||=These instructions shall be followed strictly.|These instructions will be followed strictly.|These instructions shall be strictly followed.}

He has just finished this report.
→ {||=This report has just been finished.}

notes.en: Vegetables are grown in my grandmother’s village.
notes.ru: Овощи выращивают в деревне моей бабушки.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive: are + V3. Общий факт; vegetables — множественное число.

notes.en: This strange noise was heard at midnight.
notes.ru: Этот странный шум был слышен в полночь.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3 (heard). At midnight — прошлое; noise — единственное число.

notes.en: Have you ever been bitten by the dog?
notes.ru: Вас когда-нибудь кусала эта собака?
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive в вопросе: have you ever been + V3. Ever — вопрос об опыте; подлежащее you.

notes.en: Nests are built by birds in the tall trees.
notes.ru: Птицы строят гнёзда на высоких деревьях.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive: are + V3. Общий факт; nests — множественное число.

notes.en: My hat was blown into the river by the wind.
notes.ru: Ветер сдул мою шляпу в реку.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3 (blown). Прошедшее действие; hat — единственное число.

notes.en: Who was this beautiful song written by?
notes.ru: Кем была написана эта красивая песня?
notes.why: Past Simple Passive в вопросе: was + V3; вопросительное слово who превращается в by whom или who ... by.

notes.en: Fresh bread is being sold at the market today.
notes.ru: Сегодня на рынке продают свежий хлеб.
notes.why: Present Continuous Passive: is being + V3. Today и процесс сейчас; bread — неисчисляемое, поэтому is.

notes.en: We were shown the shortest way home by the old woman.
notes.ru: Старая женщина показала нам кратчайший путь домой.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was/were + V3 (shown). При двух дополнениях любое может стать подлежащим.

notes.en: He was offered a place in the new project.
notes.ru: Ему предложили место в новом проекте.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3 (offered). При двух дополнениях любое может стать подлежащим.

notes.en: This diet was recommended to my father by the doctor.
notes.ru: Эту диету порекомендовал моему отцу врач.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3 (recommended). Прошедшее действие; diet — единственное число.

notes.en: This machine is not used anymore.
notes.ru: Эту машину больше не используют.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive с отрицанием: is not + V3. Общий факт; machine — единственное число.

notes.en: The painting was admired by everybody at the exhibition.
notes.ru: Картиной на выставке восхищались все.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: was + V3 (admired). Прошедшее действие; painting — единственное число.

notes.en: You have been waited for since early morning.
notes.ru: Вас ждут с раннего утра.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: have been + V3 (waited for). Since early morning — действие длится до сейчас; предлог for остаётся после глагола.

notes.en: These instructions shall be followed strictly.
notes.ru: Этим инструкциям мы будем строго следовать.
notes.why: Future Simple Passive: shall/will be + V3 (followed). Исходное предложение с shall относится к будущему.

notes.en: This report has just been finished.
notes.ru: Этот отчёт только что закончен.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: has been + V3. Just — недавнее действие, результат важен сейчас; report — единственное число.

exercises.task: Передайте следующие предложения в Passive Voice. Пиши предложение целиком.
items:
The students have collected all the assignments.
→ {||=All the assignments have been collected by the students.|All the assignments have been collected.}

Our aunt has placed the dishes on the top shelf.
→ {||=The dishes have been placed on the top shelf by our aunt.|The dishes have been placed on the top shelf.}

They will announce the exam results tomorrow.
→ {||=The exam results will be announced tomorrow.}

I don’t think he will complete the report today.
→ {||=I don’t think the report will be completed today.}

She often sends me postcards from abroad.
→ {||=I am often sent postcards from abroad.|Postcards are often sent to me from abroad.}

They showed us the museum’s new exhibition.
→ {||=We were shown the museum’s new exhibition.|The museum’s new exhibition was shown to us.}

They didn’t invite him to the conference.
→ {||=He was not invited to the conference.}

I didn’t leave the lights on.
→ {||=The lights were not left on.}

They did not lock the door after the meeting.
→ {||=The door was not locked after the meeting.}

I have recommended this café to many of my friends.
→ {||=This café has been recommended to many of my friends.}

She has given us the final instructions.
→ {||=We have been given the final instructions.|The final instructions have been given to us.}

Have you returned the documents yet?
→ {||=Have the documents been returned yet?}

They told me a very unusual story.
→ {||=I was told a very unusual story.|A very unusual story was told to me.}

The researchers have discovered important data.
→ {||=Important data has been discovered by the researchers.|Important data have been discovered by the researchers.|Important data has been discovered.|Important data have been discovered.}

The manager discussed the issue last Monday.
→ {||=The issue was discussed by the manager last Monday.|The issue was discussed last Monday.}

notes.en: All the assignments have been collected by the students.
notes.ru: Все задания были собраны студентами.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive (have/has been + V3): исходное have collected превращается в have been collected, а подлежащее-деятель идёт после by.

notes.en: The dishes have been placed on the top shelf by our aunt.
notes.ru: Посуда была поставлена тётей на верхнюю полку.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: has placed → have been placed; объект dishes (мн. ч.) становится подлежащим, поэтому have been.

notes.en: The exam results will be announced tomorrow.
notes.ru: Результаты экзамена будут объявлены завтра.
notes.why: Future Simple Passive (will be + V3): will announce → will be announced; маркер tomorrow указывает на будущее.

notes.en: I don’t think the report will be completed today.
notes.ru: Не думаю, что отчёт будет завершён сегодня.
notes.why: Future Simple Passive: в придаточной части he will complete the report → the report will be completed; I don't think остаётся без изменений.

notes.en: I am often sent postcards from abroad.
notes.ru: Мне часто присылают открытки из-за границы.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive (am/is/are + V3): often показывает регулярность; косвенный объект me становится подлежащим I, отсюда am sent.

notes.en: We were shown the museum’s new exhibition.
notes.ru: Нам показали новую выставку музея.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive (was/were + V3): showed — прошедшее время; us → we, подлежащее мн. ч., поэтому were shown.

notes.en: He was not invited to the conference.
notes.ru: Его не пригласили на конференцию.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive в отрицании: didn't invite → was not invited; him становится подлежащим He, единственное число — was.

notes.en: The lights were not left on.
notes.ru: Свет не был оставлен включённым.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive в отрицании: didn't leave → were not left; the lights во мн. ч., поэтому were.

notes.en: The door was not locked after the meeting.
notes.ru: Дверь не была заперта после совещания.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive в отрицании: did not lock → was not locked; the door в ед. ч., поэтому was.

notes.en: This café has been recommended to many of my friends.
notes.ru: Это кафе было рекомендовано многим моим друзьям.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: have recommended → has been recommended; новое подлежащее this café в ед. ч., поэтому has.

notes.en: We have been given the final instructions.
notes.ru: Нам дали окончательные инструкции.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: has given → have been given; us становится подлежащим We, поэтому have been.

notes.en: Have the documents been returned yet?
notes.ru: Документы уже возвращены?
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive в вопросе: have been returned; Have выносится перед подлежащим the documents (мн. ч.), yet — маркер Present Perfect.

notes.en: I was told a very unusual story.
notes.ru: Мне рассказали очень необычную историю.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: told — прошедшее время; me → I, поэтому I was told; прямой объект a story остаётся после глагола.

notes.en: Important data has been discovered by the researchers.
notes.ru: Важные данные были обнаружены исследователями.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: have discovered → has been discovered; data здесь как неисчисляемое существительное в ед. ч., поэтому has been; деятель вводится by.

notes.en: The issue was discussed by the manager last Monday.
notes.ru: Вопрос был обсуждён менеджером в прошлый понедельник.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: маркер last Monday требует прошедшего времени; discussed → was discussed (the issue в ед. ч.).

exercises.task: Переделайте следующие предложения в Passive Voice. Пиши предложение целиком.
items:
My cousin invited me to the exhibition last Friday.
→ {||=I was invited to the exhibition by my cousin last Friday.|I was invited to the exhibition last Friday by my cousin.|I was invited to the exhibition last Friday.}

They will announce the results tomorrow morning.
→ {||=The results will be announced tomorrow morning.}

The workers repaired the bridge in 2019.
→ {||=The bridge was repaired by the workers in 2019.|The bridge was repaired in 2019.}

They were selling fresh fruit in that market when I arrived.
→ {||=Fresh fruit was being sold in that market when I arrived.}

A group of volunteers cleaned the beach last weekend.
→ {||=The beach was cleaned by a group of volunteers last weekend.|The beach was cleaned last weekend by a group of volunteers.}

A famous architect designed this building.
→ {||=This building was designed by a famous architect.}

They are translating his new novel now.
→ {||=His new novel is being translated now.}

My uncle wrote this letter two days ago.
→ {||=This letter was written by my uncle two days ago.|This letter was written two days ago by my uncle.}

Several experts reviewed the project last month.
→ {||=The project was reviewed by several experts last month.|The project was reviewed last month by several experts.}

They have cancelled the meeting.
→ {||=The meeting has been cancelled.}

The teacher corrected all our tests yesterday.
→ {||=All our tests were corrected by the teacher yesterday.|All our tests were corrected yesterday.}

The scientists discovered a rare species of plant.
→ {||=A rare species of plant was discovered by the scientists.|A rare species of plant was discovered.}

The children painted the walls in bright colours.
→ {||=The walls were painted in bright colours by the children.|The walls were painted by the children in bright colours.|The walls were painted in bright colours.}

Someone had taken the documents from the desk.
→ {||=The documents had been taken from the desk.}

They often invite her to international conferences.
→ {||=She is often invited to international conferences.}

notes.en: I was invited to the exhibition by my cousin last Friday.
notes.ru: Меня пригласил на выставку мой двоюродный брат в прошлую пятницу.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: invited с маркером last Friday → was invited; me становится подлежащим I, деятель вводится by.

notes.en: The results will be announced tomorrow morning.
notes.ru: Результаты будут объявлены завтра утром.
notes.why: Future Simple Passive: will announce → will be announced; маркер tomorrow morning указывает на будущее.

notes.en: The bridge was repaired by the workers in 2019.
notes.ru: Мост был отремонтирован рабочими в 2019 году.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: in 2019 — прошедшее время; repaired → was repaired (the bridge в ед. ч.).

notes.en: Fresh fruit was being sold in that market when I arrived.
notes.ru: Свежие фрукты продавались на том рынке, когда я приехал.
notes.why: Past Continuous Passive (was/were being + V3): в активе were selling — длительное действие, прерванное arrived; fruit — неисчисляемое, поэтому was being sold.

notes.en: The beach was cleaned by a group of volunteers last weekend.
notes.ru: Пляж был убран группой волонтёров в прошлые выходные.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: last weekend — прошедшее время; cleaned → was cleaned (the beach в ед. ч.).

notes.en: This building was designed by a famous architect.
notes.ru: Это здание было спроектировано известным архитектором.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: designed → was designed; this building в ед. ч., деятель a famous architect вводится by.

notes.en: His new novel is being translated now.
notes.ru: Его новый роман сейчас переводят.
notes.why: Present Continuous Passive (am/is/are being + V3): now и are translating → is being translated; his new novel в ед. ч.

notes.en: This letter was written by my uncle two days ago.
notes.ru: Это письмо было написано моим дядей два дня назад.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: ago указывает на прошедшее; wrote (V2) → was written (V3); this letter в ед. ч.

notes.en: The project was reviewed by several experts last month.
notes.ru: Проект был рассмотрен несколькими экспертами в прошлом месяце.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: last month — прошедшее время; reviewed → was reviewed (the project в ед. ч.).

notes.en: The meeting has been cancelled.
notes.ru: Встреча была отменена.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: have cancelled → has been cancelled; the meeting в ед. ч., поэтому has been.

notes.en: All our tests were corrected by the teacher yesterday.
notes.ru: Все наши контрольные были проверены учителем вчера.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: yesterday — прошедшее время; corrected → were corrected, так как all our tests во мн. ч.

notes.en: A rare species of plant was discovered by the scientists.
notes.ru: Учёными был обнаружен редкий вид растения.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: discovered — прошедшее время; a rare species в ед. ч., поэтому was discovered.

notes.en: The walls were painted in bright colours by the children.
notes.ru: Стены были покрашены детьми в яркие цвета.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: painted → were painted; the walls во мн. ч., поэтому were.

notes.en: The documents had been taken from the desk.
notes.ru: Документы были взяты со стола.
notes.why: Past Perfect Passive (had been + V3): had taken → had been taken; неопределённое someone в пассиве опускается.

notes.en: She is often invited to international conferences.
notes.ru: Её часто приглашают на международные конференции.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive: often показывает регулярность; invite → is invited; her становится подлежащим She, поэтому is.

exercises.task: Переделайте следующие предложения в Passive Voice. Пиши предложение целиком.
items:
They searched the old house carefully.
→ {||=The old house was searched carefully.|The old house was carefully searched.}

The students did not understand the rule.
→ {||=The rule was not understood by the students.|The rule was not understood.}

She takes care of her younger brothers.
→ {||=Her younger brothers are taken care of.}

They asked us many strange questions.
→ {||=We were asked many strange questions.}

My uncle repaired the roof yesterday.
→ {||=The roof was repaired by my uncle yesterday.|The roof was repaired yesterday.}

He will send me the documents next week.
→ {||=I will be sent the documents next week.|The documents will be sent to me next week.}

A friend of my mother has brought us fresh vegetables.
→ {||=We have been brought fresh vegetables by a friend of my mother.|Fresh vegetables have been brought to us by a friend of my mother.|We have been brought fresh vegetables.|Fresh vegetables have been brought to us.}

His teacher told him the correct answer.
→ {||=He was told the correct answer by his teacher.|He was told the correct answer.|The correct answer was told to him by his teacher.}

The workers welcomed the new manager warmly.
→ {||=The new manager was welcomed warmly by the workers.|The new manager was warmly welcomed by the workers.|The new manager was welcomed warmly.|The new manager was warmly welcomed.}

They have recently painted the entire building.
→ {||=The entire building has recently been painted.|The entire building has been painted recently.}

We must complete the report by tomorrow morning.
→ {||=The report must be completed by tomorrow morning.}

When I cut my hand, my neighbour called the doctor.
→ {||=When I cut my hand, the doctor was called by my neighbour.|When I cut my hand, the doctor was called.}

They showed Tom the quickest way to the station.
→ {||=Tom was shown the quickest way to the station.|The quickest way to the station was shown to Tom.}

She gave her sister some useful advice.
→ {||=Her sister was given some useful advice.|Some useful advice was given to her sister.}

John has told me several interesting stories.
→ {||=I have been told several interesting stories by John.|I have been told several interesting stories.|Several interesting stories have been told to me by John.}

notes.en: The old house was searched carefully.
notes.ru: Старый дом был тщательно обыскан.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: searched — прошедшее время; the old house в ед. ч., поэтому was searched; наречие carefully остаётся в предложении.

notes.en: The rule was not understood by the students.
notes.ru: Правило не было понято студентами.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive в отрицании: did not understand → was not understood; the rule в ед. ч.

notes.en: Her younger brothers are taken care of.
notes.ru: О её младших братьях заботятся.
notes.why: Present Simple Passive: takes care of → are taken care of; брать глагол целиком с предлогом, подлежащее brothers во мн. ч. — are.

notes.en: We were asked many strange questions.
notes.ru: Нам задали много странных вопросов.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: asked — прошедшее время; us → We, поэтому We were asked; прямой объект questions остаётся после глагола.

notes.en: The roof was repaired by my uncle yesterday.
notes.ru: Крыша была отремонтирована моим дядей вчера.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: yesterday — прошедшее время; repaired → was repaired (the roof в ед. ч.).

notes.en: I will be sent the documents next week.
notes.ru: Мне отправят документы на следующей неделе.
notes.why: Future Simple Passive (will be + V3): will send → will be sent; me становится подлежащим I, маркер next week — будущее.

notes.en: We have been brought fresh vegetables by a friend of my mother.
notes.ru: Друг моей мамы принёс нам свежие овощи.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: has brought → have been brought; us → We, подлежащее мн. ч., поэтому have been.

notes.en: He was told the correct answer by his teacher.
notes.ru: Ему сообщил правильный ответ его учитель.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: told — прошедшее время; him → He, поэтому He was told; деятель his teacher вводится by.

notes.en: The new manager was welcomed warmly by the workers.
notes.ru: Новый менеджер был тепло встречен рабочими.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: welcomed → was welcomed; the new manager в ед. ч., наречие warmly остаётся, деятель вводится by.

notes.en: The entire building has recently been painted.
notes.ru: Всё здание недавно покрасили.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: have painted → has been painted; the entire building в ед. ч., recently — маркер Present Perfect.

notes.en: The report must be completed by tomorrow morning.
notes.ru: Отчёт должен быть завершён к завтрашнему утру.
notes.why: Passive с модальным глаголом: must + be + V3; must complete → must be completed.

notes.en: When I cut my hand, the doctor was called by my neighbour.
notes.ru: Когда я порезал руку, сосед вызвал врача.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: called → was called; the doctor в ед. ч.; придаточная часть When I cut my hand остаётся неизменной.

notes.en: Tom was shown the quickest way to the station.
notes.ru: Тому показали самый короткий путь до станции.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: showed — прошедшее время; косвенный объект Tom становится подлежащим, поэтому Tom was shown.

notes.en: Her sister was given some useful advice.
notes.ru: Её сестре дали полезный совет.
notes.why: Past Simple Passive: gave — прошедшее время; her sister становится подлежащим в ед. ч., поэтому was given.

notes.en: I have been told several interesting stories by John.
notes.ru: Мне рассказали несколько интересных историй.
notes.why: Present Perfect Passive: has told → have been told; me → I, поэтому I have been told; деятель John вводится by.

exercises.task: Переведите предложения в Passive Voice: модальный глагол + be + V3. Пиши предложение целиком.
items:
You must close all the windows before you leave.
→ {||=All the windows must be closed before you leave.}

They can repair your phone by tomorrow evening.
→ {||=Your phone can be repaired by tomorrow evening.}

You should return these documents to the office today.
→ {||=These documents should be returned to the office today.}

They have to check all the files before the meeting.
→ {||=All the files have to be checked before the meeting.}

People must follow these rules during the experiment.
→ {||=These rules must be followed during the experiment.}

You can take this book from any shelf.
→ {||=This book can be taken from any shelf.}

They may finish the project earlier than expected.
→ {||=The project may be finished earlier than expected.}

Someone must deliver the package before noon.
→ {||=The package must be delivered before noon.}

They ought to clean the room before guests arrive.
→ {||=The room ought to be cleaned before guests arrive.}

You must send the report immediately.
→ {||=The report must be sent immediately.}

They should water the plants every morning.
→ {||=The plants should be watered every morning.}

You have to wear this uniform in the lab.
→ {||=This uniform has to be worn in the lab.}

Someone can open the door from the reception desk.
→ {||=The door can be opened from the reception desk.}

They must not use phones during the exam.
→ {||=Phones must not be used during the exam.}

They can’t publish this article without permission.
→ {||=This article can’t be published without permission.}

notes.en: All the windows must be closed before you leave.
notes.ru: Все окна должны быть закрыты, прежде чем вы уйдёте.
notes.why: Задание требует модальный глагол + be + V3: must close → must be closed; объект all the windows становится подлежащим.

notes.en: Your phone can be repaired by tomorrow evening.
notes.ru: Ваш телефон могут отремонтировать к завтрашнему вечеру.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: can repair → can be repaired; your phone становится подлежащим.

notes.en: These documents should be returned to the office today.
notes.ru: Эти документы следует вернуть в офис сегодня.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: should return → should be returned; these documents становится подлежащим.

notes.en: All the files have to be checked before the meeting.
notes.ru: Все файлы нужно проверить до совещания.
notes.why: have to + be + V3: have to check → have to be checked; подлежащее all the files во мн. ч., поэтому have to.

notes.en: These rules must be followed during the experiment.
notes.ru: Эти правила должны соблюдаться во время эксперимента.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: must follow → must be followed; these rules становится подлежащим.

notes.en: This book can be taken from any shelf.
notes.ru: Эту книгу можно взять с любой полки.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: can take → can be taken; V3 от take — taken.

notes.en: The project may be finished earlier than expected.
notes.ru: Проект, возможно, будет закончен раньше, чем ожидалось.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: may finish → may be finished; the project становится подлежащим.

notes.en: The package must be delivered before noon.
notes.ru: Посылка должна быть доставлена до полудня.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: must deliver → must be delivered; неопределённое someone в пассиве опускается.

notes.en: The room ought to be cleaned before guests arrive.
notes.ru: Комнату следует убрать до прихода гостей.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: ought to clean → ought to be cleaned; ought to сохраняет to, после него be + V3.

notes.en: The report must be sent immediately.
notes.ru: Отчёт должен быть отправлен немедленно.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: must send → must be sent; V3 от send — sent.

notes.en: The plants should be watered every morning.
notes.ru: Растения следует поливать каждое утро.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: should water → should be watered; the plants становится подлежащим.

notes.en: This uniform has to be worn in the lab.
notes.ru: Эту форму нужно носить в лаборатории.
notes.why: have to + be + V3: have to wear → has to be worn; подлежащее this uniform в ед. ч., поэтому has to; V3 от wear — worn.

notes.en: The door can be opened from the reception desk.
notes.ru: Дверь можно открыть со стойки регистрации.
notes.why: Модальный Passive: can open → can be opened; неопределённое someone в пассиве опускается.

notes.en: Phones must not be used during the exam.
notes.ru: Телефоны нельзя использовать во время экзамена.
notes.why: Модальный Passive в отрицании: must not use → must not be used; отрицание стоит после модального глагола.

notes.en: This article can’t be published without permission.
notes.ru: Эту статью нельзя публиковать без разрешения.
notes.why: Модальный Passive в отрицании: can't publish → can't be published; the article становится подлежащим.
